:::{#exm-poisson-log-partition-mean}
#### The mean of the Poisson distribution from its log-partition function

<!-- no-figure: the example compares two numbers computed from the same rate -->

In @exm-poisson-exponential-family,
the statistic is $\statf{\rvar} = \rvar$
and the log-partition function is $\logpartitionf{\natparam} = \expf{\natparam}$.
By @thm-log-partition-mean,

$$
\E{\Rvar}
= \E{\statf{\Rvar}}
= \dif{\logpartitionf{\natparam}}{\natparam}
= \expf{\natparam}.
$$

Since $\expf{\natparam} = \rate$,
this is the mean of the Poisson distribution, $\rate$.
For the cyclone data, the derivative at the natural parameter $\natparam = `r round(natural_parameter, 3)`$ is
$\expf{\natparam} = `r round(exp(natural_parameter), 3)`$,
which equals the rate set to the sample mean, `r round(rate, 3)`.
:::
